11.text: I saw Elena's eyes rest on my Wruhecist prayer medallion. I wore it on my chest almost constantly now.

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "You already know what's going on. So I will keep this short."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Thank you for staying by my side all these years. I know it was not always easy."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "The wisdom and integrity with which you have served the Rizian throne will never be forgotten."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Our kingdom is undergoing a transformation. And unfortunately, it could not do so without casualties."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "I wish that I could keep you on my new council. Alas, it is not God's will."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "It is nothing personal. But my Holy Kingdom must be led by those with the utmost purity of faith."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "As has been prophesied, only a council of true Wruhecist believers can bring forth Golconda in Rizia."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I wish that I could have kept you on. But alas, the very concept of a Royal Council went against my reform goals."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "Should you wish to run for elected office under Rizia's new government structure, I will support you."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "Most of you are getting on in years, anyway. The governance of this country shouldn't be trusted to a group of senior citizens."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: My councilors frowned at each other.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: My councilors frowned at each other. Finally, Elena spoke up.

29.speaker: Elena Werner
29.text: "Thank you anyway for the opportunity, Your Majesty. It has been a pleasure serving three generations of the Toras family."

33.speaker: Elena Werner
33.text: "I am glad to have helped you build the foundations for a profitable kingdom going forward. Even if I won't be part of it."

37.speaker: Elena Werner
37.text: "And I am looking forward to seeing our nation become a great energy powerhouse."

38.speaker: Elena Werner
38.text: "I hope the new government will have more success than I did in building the foundations for a profitable future."

39.speaker: Elena Werner
39.text: "And I hope that one day Rizia may become the great energy powerhouse I envisioned."

46.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
46.text: "For my part, I am glad to have played a role in the formation of the Interkopum Alliance. If we are lucky, the connections we have built will outlive us all."

47.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
47.text: "Of course, I deeply regret that I did not do more to prevent the Pales War. So many lives lost..."

51.text: "For my part, I am glad to have played a small role in the reunification of Pales and Rizia. If it all goes according to plan, the course of history will be changed."

55.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
55.text: "Of course, I deeply regret that I did not do more to prevent the loss of Zille."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Do you have something to say, Your Grace?"

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Uncle Hugo, I hope you will forgive me. We are still family, after all."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "I am sorry, Hugo. But you must understand why I did what I did."

69.speaker: Hugo Toras
69.text: "I understand. But I wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "My hand was forced by circumstances beyond my control. If I did not dissolve the Royal Council, Rizia would have fallen prey to revolutionaries."

74.speaker: Hugo Toras
74.text: "I am a man of God as well, after all."

78.speaker: Hugo Toras
78.text: "I hope you remember that I was the one who set you on the path of Wruhecist enlightenment in the first place."

82.speaker: Hugo Toras
82.text: "Only that I wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

86.speaker: Hugo Toras
86.text: "We are. But I do wish I had a larger part to play in this new theocracy."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "I do not doubt your devotion, Hugo. I will continue to cherish and value your advice, even if you are no longer my official Grand Vizier."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Your faith only goes skin deep. As for me, it lives within my very soul."

92.speaker: Hugo Toras
92.text: "I supported your new constitution in our talks before, and I do now."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "You have not seen the future. You don't know the prophecies. Grand Wiseman Ignacius does."

94.speaker: Hugo Toras
94.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I appreciate that."

95.speaker: Hugo Toras
95.text: "I beg to differ, Your Majesty. But your mind is clearly made up."

96.speaker: Hugo Toras
96.text: "Of course I do not question the Grand Wiseman's vision."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "I let you live. Count yourself lucky."

102.speaker: Elena Werner
102.text: "You have most decidedly strayed from the path followed by Queen Lyza and King Valero."

106.speaker: Elena Werner
106.text: "But I wish you the best of luck in this new direction."

107.speaker: Elena Werner
107.text: "And I'll miss all your little japes."

111.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
111.text: "For my part, I am glad to have played a small role in the return of Zille. Truly a historic feat."
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Efforts"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_Rizia_Unification"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] == true)

112.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
112.text: "But I hope the change in government brings a fresh start and new possibilities for peace."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Please feel free to visit the Palace anytime."

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: My now ex-councilors left, closing the door behind them.

124.speaker: Hugo Toras
124.text: "I did not support your reforms when you introduced them, and I do not now. But ultimately, it was not my choice to make."

125.speaker: Hugo Toras
125.text: "I just hope you will continue to seek my advice when you need it."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "You advised me to marry your son to my daughter. You don't exactly have a stellar track record."

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: Hugo struggled to keep a smile on his face.

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "I will. Nobody knows our house and Valenqiris better than you."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "I won't need it. But thanks for the offer."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "You still have a valuable role to play, Your Grace. We all do."

134.speaker: Hugo Toras
134.text: "I was trying to set the monarchy back on track after the mistakes my brother made. I didn't know that you were planning to derail it altogether."

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: Hugo struggled to keep a smile on his face.

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: He and the others lined up in front of me. I shook each of their hands in turn.

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "I wish you all a happy retirement."
